svg.title: A breast complaint divided by how she presents: a lump (benign or worrisome, imaged by age then sampled), breast pain (cyclical or mastitis), nipple discharge (galactorrhea or pathological, usually a papilloma) and screening (usual or high risk, with carcinoma in situ split into DCIS and LCIS); each column gives presentation, numbered investigations and management, with the biopsy risk tiers and genetic testing below

svg.text: A breast problem: how is she PRESENTING?

text.font-family: Arial, 'Segoe UI Symbol', 'Liberation Sans', Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: most breast lumps are NOT cancer · the OLDER she is, the more likely any complaint is serious

text.font-family: Arial, 'Segoe UI Symbol', 'Liberation Sans', Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: every one: history (age, cycle, family history) · offer a chaperone · examine both breasts + every node group

svg.text: • IMAGE BY AGE: < 35 ULTRASOUND (breast too dense, risk too low for

text.font-family: Arial, 'Segoe UI Symbol', 'Liberation Sans', Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: a mammogram; MRI if high risk), > 35 MAMMOGRAM ± ultrasound

svg.text: • then SAMPLE: fine needle aspiration → core biopsy → excision

svg.text: The benign biopsy report sets her cancer risk

text.font-family: Arial, 'Segoe UI Symbol', 'Liberation Sans', Helvetica, sans-serif
Arial, 'Segoe UI Symbol', 'Liberation Sans', Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: • proliferative without atypia, ×1.5–2: papilloma, sclerosing adenosis, radial scar

text.font-family: Arial, 'Segoe UI Symbol', 'Liberation Sans', Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: • ATYPICAL hyperplasia, ×4–5 (×9–10 with a family history) → screen YEARLY

text.font-family: Arial, 'Segoe UI Symbol', 'Liberation Sans', Helvetica, sans-serif
Arial, 'Segoe UI Symbol', 'Liberation Sans', Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: • HIGH risk, YEARLY mammogram: 1st-degree relative < 50, or two at any age · ovarian cancer · male breast cancer in the family ·

text.font-family: Arial, 'Segoe UI Symbol', 'Liberation Sans', Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: atypia, LCIS, radial scar, phyllodes · density > 75%

text.font-family: Arial, 'Segoe UI Symbol', 'Liberation Sans', Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: • usual risk: NOT ultrasound, MRI, clinical breast exam or self-exam

text.font-family: Arial, 'Segoe UI Symbol', 'Liberation Sans', Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: • GENETIC TESTING if she has breast cancer and is < 35 · < 50 with two affected relatives · male · Ashkenazi Jewish

text.font-family: Arial, 'Segoe UI Symbol', 'Liberation Sans', Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: • BRCA carrier: yearly MRI + mammogram · prophylactic mastectomy ± oophorectomy · tamoxifen
